entries.094122d1c23aedc3: This business manufactures and sells processed oils and fats such as fats for chocolate, as well as business-use edible oil and processing oils and fats, in Malaysia and other overseas markets.
entries.15f891e448c4eb31: This business manufactures and sells, mainly in Japan, edible oils for household and business use, processing oils and fats, meal (oil cake), as well as chocolate, dressings, and MCT-related foods. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥389,586 million (99.8% of the previous year), making it the largest reportable segment. In Oils, Fats and Oilseeds, prices were revised amid continued rises in raw material costs, but sales volumes declined, mainly for home-use products. In Processed Foods and Materials, revenue increased due to price revisions for chocolate.
entries.186e69cd277eb026: This business manufactures and sells processed oils and fats such as fats for chocolate, as well as business-use edible oil and processing oils and fats, in Malaysia and other overseas markets. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥138,848 million (120.3% of the previous year), an increase. Because cocoa bean prices soared in the previous fiscal year, demand rose for chocolate fats that can substitute for cocoa butter, and selling prices also rose as palm oil prices increased. The main business is conducted by consolidated subsidiary Intercontinental Specialty Fats Sdn. Bhd., and subsidiaries in Italy and Shanghai also handle processed oils and fats. This category was newly established from the fiscal year 2025, and figures for the previous year have been restated to the new category in disclosures.

entries.45643eee619e386d: This category covers edible oils (home use and business use), processing oils and fats, processed oils and fats, and meal, which the company manufactures and sells. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥311,544 million (99.7% of the previous year). Business-use and processing-use products increased due to price revisions, while home-use products declined as sales volumes fell. Soybean meal and rapeseed meal declined in revenue as unit selling prices fell. entries.6991f802bd5b5ec1: This business manufactures and sells raw materials for cosmetics and toiletries, chemical products, and vegetable industrial oils. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥15,509 million (106.6% of the previous year). In makeup products as well as skincare products, proposals accompanied by technical support were advanced, and new domestic adoptions increased, leading to higher revenue. In addition to the company, Industrial Quimica Lasem, S.A.U. in Spain manufactures and sells cosmetic raw materials and other products.

entries.6e3be3d372c40846: Consolidated revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥554,251 million, up from ¥530,878 million in the previous year, a year-on-year ratio of 104.4%.
